description: This file defines features and workarounds for Direct3D (D3D) driver bugs and issues within the ANGLE project, including structures for compiler workarounds and feature flags for various D3D-related workarounds.

classes.name: CompilerWorkaroundsD3D
classes.description: Struct holding boolean flags for D3D compiler workarounds such as optimization skipping and IEEE strictness.

classes.name: FeaturesD3D
classes.description: Class representing a set of D3D features and workarounds, including multiple feature flags for specific driver bugs and issues.
